item.title: Revolucionando la Gestión de Paquetes con Ringsce Engine: Código Abierto para Paquetes RPM y Debian
item.description: En el ámbito del desarrollo y distribución de software, los sistemas de gestión de paquetes eficientes juegan un papel fundamental en garantizar la implementación y mantenimiento fluido de aplicaciones en diversas plataformas. Entre los sistemas de gestión de paquetes destacados, los formatos de paquetes RPM (Red Hat Package Manager) y Debian han sido durante mucho tiempo pilares del ecosistema Linux. La reciente aparición de Ringsce Engine como una solución de código abierto ha marcado un avance significativo en la simplificación de la gestión de paquetes RPM y Debian.

item.title: ringsce engine for Linux
item.description: In the realm of software development and distribution, efficient package management systems play a pivotal role in ensuring seamless deployment and maintenance of applications across various platforms. Among the prominent package management systems, RPM (Red Hat Package Manager) and Debian package formats have long been pillars of the Linux ecosystem. The recent emergence of Ringsce Engine as an open-source solution has marked a significant advancement in simplifying the management of RPM and Debian packages.

item.title: Introduction
item.description:
Introducing Ekron RPG: Unleash Your Adventure with ringsCE Engine

In the bustling landscape of gaming, emerges a new titan: Ekron RPG, a revolutionary role-playing game designed to redefine immersive storytelling and gameplay dynamics. Powered by the groundbreaking ringsCE engine, Ekron RPG offers players an unparalleled journey into realms of fantasy, mystery, and exploration.

Embark on an Epic Quest:
In Ekron RPG, players are thrust into a vibrant and dynamic world teeming with rich lore and diverse landscapes. Whether traversing through enchanted forests, scaling treacherous mountains, or delving into the depths of ancient ruins, every corner of Ekron’s universe is ripe with adventure and discovery.

item.title: ringsCE 0.2
item.description:
Hello,

ringsCE has been rolled out for 0.2 version. This version will be implemented until July, where we are going to release the major version 0.5. With this version you can implement for now a launcher, an editor for Pascal, C++, with almost syntax.

git clone --recursive https://github.com/ringsce/west

With this roll out you can see a new project as guideline called movement desktop project.

We are delivering a digital platform for macOS, Linux for now. We are working on an iOS and android application to read the feed.

item.title: ringsCE status #2
item.description:

Adding sdl2 and tango icons on a submodule git.

item.title: ringsCE status
item.description:
Hello readers,

Today, we are going to learn how to build the proof of concept of ringsCE framework and its API.

mkdir poc && cd poc
git clone https://github.com/ringsce-editor editor
git clone https://github.com/west west


cd editor
cd intel
open project1.lpi 


compile
run without debugging

Now, we are going to see how to build a qt6 application for launcher. The CMakeLists.txt is not yet implemented. Next ticket to do.
